source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The filter-list document loads filterEditor.ftl and uses Fluent attributes for its controls. The saved-view list reuses the new, edit and delete button IDs without removing its other DTD resources. Programmatic incompatibility text uses the product-name term; the migration replaces both old brand-placeholder forms. The accepted completed/ migration is byte-identical to the owned script. Its archive location proves retained source identity only; automatic migration discovery and execution were not inspected.
title: Filter-list Fluent migration keeps markup attributes, shared buttons and branded prompts in separate consumers
